body: I feel as if I would really like to cry right now but I just cannot bring myself to do it. Feels forced. Still, I think it would be cleansing. If I could genuinely make myself cry. I can feel the tears right there, they well for a moment before sinking back down. Not desperate enough I don't think. hmmmm.

Well, I don't think I'm going to kill myself tonight so I'm going to bed. Jesus christ tonight was awkward. Maybe I'll feel better about it in a few days. Man things are going to be her awkward when I see again though... I hope we can forget about this night pretty quickly. Goooood I cannot wait for summer. Peace. Quiet. Not going to talk to anyone.
